english: What do you do in the evening? In the evening we sit by the fire. My brother sings and my sons listen. What does he sing? He sings the fame of men.

english: How many stars are in the sky? No one knows. My mother says the stars are the cows of the sky. Who guards them? The moon guards them.
Why do you laugh? My son was born yesterday. My heart is filled with joy. May he live and grow! Come and drink!
I saw a dream in the night. What did you see? A wolf (wolves? INS.PL form) followed me. I was afraid. Do not be afraid! A dream is not a wolf. The wolf of a dream eats no one.
